accepted_source_findings: Preparation snapshots current raw values and invokes the retained registry class on a fresh clone; original class-default overlay is not transplanted.
Current parent path reaches exact child identity; original path key must agree with source-bundle slot model type, architecture and files.
Address descriptor is joined to raw/config/loader/merge cache key; changes cannot hit an unaddressed or differently addressed entry.
Replay validates address before returning bytes, binds recorded checkpoint to current raw, and requires package dependencies; no torch/transformers/diffusers import in descriptor or replay.
Slot context now consumes the current preparation overlay and keeps failure limited.

Tests cover current dependent-default recalculation, explicit null rejection, config-key rename without borrowed values, foreign descriptors, replay without heavy imports, and changed input/support-source misses.

blocking_findings.problem: Direct Path.read_bytes on every retained source is outside cache-miss and typed preparation handling, before even checking if a cache transaction exists. An unavailable source file can cause uncaught OSError during lawful missing-evidence preparation.
blocking_findings.required: Handle source availability through bounded typed failure/cache miss while preserving foreign descriptor rejection; poison unavailable modeling/supporting source both with caching disabled and historical replay.

scope_limits: Source inspection and exact hash verification only; no runtime or browser.
Synthetic test source is reviewed, not reported passing.
Same-process third-party registry mutation without source/version changes remains the declared cache blind spot.
